name: Friedrich Zölner

events.place: Gross Hluscha, Kovelsky Uyezd, Volhynian Governorate, Russian Empire

notes:
Alfred & Hulda provided data in Feb.99 which was compiled by a cousin in Germany and he indicates Friedrich lived in Altenhagen, Germany.  On an accompanying sheet, the date of birth is in conflict as Jan. 25, 1900.The supporting sheet indicates he married a Regina (last name unknown), but birth and death dates are provided as is their residence of "Bielfeld".
On February 20,2006, while examining LDS film # 0161447 for the town of Rinnersdorf, the Marriage Banns notice of the marriage between Friedrich Zelmer (#1359) and Regina Kubsch was found.  Friedrich's spouse was previously  thought to be "Vinbsch" but that name has now been changed to Kubsch.  Friedrich's birthdate is shown as January 25, 1900 in Kl. Gluscha.  The confirmation certificate was from the church office in Lubiaszewo.  He was a resident of Sternberg.
The original copy from film 0161447 and the interpretation by Regina Steffensen has been filed in the Zelmer Red Book, Vol. 1.
